comment-block.comment: The same two forms a program uses, so a project file is annotated the same way.
comment-block.name: comment.block.profi-c

path.comment: The three lines whose argument is a place on disk. A word that is not part of the vocabulary is reported by the compiler, and is left unhighlighted here so that it looks as wrong as it is.

entry.comment: Which Program the build begins at. Scoped as a type rather than as a path, because that is what it is: the namespaces in front of the type and the type, written as a 'using' would write it.

ignore.comment: What every file the project builds should stop being told. The argument is accepted exactly where the compiler accepts one — a severity or a diagnostic — so a line naming anything else stays unhighlighted, which is what the compiler says about it too.
